newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia T-bill prices up on yield fall expectations.
newsitem.headline: Russia T-bill prices up on yield fall expectations.

text.p: Prices of Russian government paper edged up on Friday on banks' expectations of a yield fall to 19 percent, dealers said, forecasting the trend would continue on Monday.
*Average yield fell to 18.55 pct from 18.74 pct on Thursday
*Turnover rose to 4.05 trln rbls from 5.16 trln rbls
*Central bank sold 905 trln rbls worth of paper
"Prices edged up, while the yield slipped in line with our expectations with no strong fluctuations," a dealer said.
Dealers said prices of long-term paper rose by an average 0.15-0.20 percentage points, prices of short-term paper by an average 0.10 percentage points.

"Government paper prices rose immediately after the trading started," said Kredit-Moskva dealer Nikolai Yeliseyev. "Although banks transferred a lot of money to the trading system, the turnover was small. There were big lots for sale on long-term paper, but it looks like 19 percent is their resistance level."
